title: Professional
description: The SHERQ ACADEMY is a professional training center licensed by the Ministry of Science and Technology, Higher Education and Technical-Professional and accredited by the National Authority for Professional Education of Mozambique.
missionTitle: Training that Transforms People and Organizations
missionText1: We specialize in the development of technical and behavioral skills, operating in two main areas: machine and equipment operation and interpersonal skills.
missionText2: We develop tailor-made training for each organization, analyzing specific needs together with the company to design and implement training actions adapted to their strategy.
missionText3: Our methodology ensures that each training is planned as the most suitable solution to transform people and enhance organizational results.

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: To develop professional skills through quality training, contributing to the valorization of human resources and the sustainable growth of organizations in Mozambique.

vision.label: Vision
vision.text: To be the reference training center in Mozambique, recognized for excellence in professional training and contribution to the country's socioeconomic development.
